checkpoints.question: What starts the four additional ToF sensor services on a Duckiedrone?
checkpoints.model_answer: The duckiedrone/extra_sensors stack starts the front, left, right, and top ToF sensor services in addition to the standard bottom sensor path.

evidence.label: Activity 1: start the other four sensors

checkpoints.question: How does the subscriber distinguish readings from all five ToF sensors?
checkpoints.model_answer: It subscribes to one topic for each configured sensor and keeps each reading associated with that sensor name.

checkpoints.question: Why are four ToF sensors off by default, and how many containers does starting them add?
checkpoints.model_answer: Each added sensor needs a driver and a ROS 2 bridge, so starting the other four adds eight containers. Their processor cost on the Raspberry Pi is why they stay off by default.
